## About
An official Texas inspection station, right on Mockingbird Lane.

## Services
- Annual state vehicle inspection: The annual state vehicle inspection, as required by the state of Texas.
- Repairs related to safety of vehicle: Repairs related to the safety of your vehicle, which are not part of the inspection.
- Advice if your vehicle fails the inspection: We provide advice to customers if their vehicle fails the inspection.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. We don't schedule appointments by phone or email. It's first come, first served, so just stop by during business hours.

Q: What should I bring for my inspection?
A: Bring proof of liability insurance for your vehicle.

Q: I just moved to Texas. What do I need to do?
A: New residents need to get a vehicle inspection and then register and title their vehicle within 30 days of moving. Your vehicle must pass inspection before it can be registered and titled.

Q: Do diesel and electric vehicles need an emissions test?
A: Diesel powered and electric vehicles are exempt from the emissions test.
